scope: Public calibrated photometry and independently acquired calibrated detector image planes; original detector raw science/calibration images documented public but not needed/acquired for this bounded test.
source_version_note: Current pinned SNANA code is not asserted identical to unpublished original executable. Effective default crosscheck supplied by official reproduction agent; separate code/minimizer register there.

assumptions.assumption: Released FLUXCAL is calibrated signed flux on 27.5mag scale; it is not raw detector counts. Corrections already embedded must not be applied twice.
assumptions.why_needed: Sets physical meaning and prevents duplicate host-error/DCR/chromatic corrections.
assumptions.empirical_falsifier: Source README/config contradictions or raw-vs-LCPLOT amplitude disagreement.
assumptions.result: Release config comments disable already embedded corrections. Targeted raw-vs-published LCPLOT agrees to text precision. DR2 calibrated CCD images obtained independently are in electrons.
assumptions.identifiability: This verifies representation, not the physical correctness of every applied correction.

assumptions.assumption: Quadratic flux residual objective is adequate for the accepted measurements after covariance and clipping.
assumptions.why_needed: Needed to interpret parameter estimates and reported fit uncertainty as a measurement likelihood.
assumptions.empirical_falsifier: Off-signal/held-out standardized residuals have systematic offsets, excessive width/tails or dependence unexplained by known contamination.
assumptions.result: Quality DIFFIMG >365day mean-0.861,RMS2.944; heldout cross-season baseline with conservative propagated uncertainty mean-0.038,RMS1.664 and >3tail5.16%. SMP >200day robust width1.054 but heavy tails; SMP has zero >365day support.
assumptions.identifiability: DIFFIMG has older reduction, baseline contamination and non-cosmology optimization. No direct proof of SMP likelihood failure or cosmology bias. Published residuals are fit/clipping conditioned.

assumptions.assumption: Measurement errors enter the covariance diagonal unless explicit data covariance fudge is requested. SALT model and MW covariance are separately nonzero.
assumptions.why_needed: Independent measurement-error treatment can overweight repeated/shared-reference errors.
assumptions.empirical_falsifier: Exact full-row repetitions or shared-baseline/neighbor dependence unexplained by the implemented model/MW covariance.
assumptions.result: Measurement variance only diagonal at10703–10706; COVFUDGE_DATA returns0 for blank default; model+MW terms retained. Exact full-record repeat pairs4328 across1550objects. Shared off-signal offsets detected in DIFFIMG.
assumptions.identifiability: Repeated field key alone does not prove a duplicated independent measurement: A/B variants often differ in detector coordinates. Exact records strongly challenge treating all rows as new information, but parent measurement lineage and impact require controlled refit.

assumptions.assumption: SMP galaxy/reference modeling and nightly inverse-variance averaging adequately marginalize shared image/scene uncertainties.
assumptions.why_needed: A galaxy scene and astrometric centroid fitted jointly across epochs can correlate flux errors; nightly averaging assumes the relevant independence or covariance treatment.
assumptions.empirical_falsifier: Recovered image/scene posterior yields additional epoch covariance, or heldout reference-season baselines show unmodeled structure.
assumptions.result: Public paper describes joint transient+host fit, posterior-derived flux errors, source/hostPoisson additions and nightly averaging; PHOT supplies scalar uncertainties, not scene posterior or full epoch covariance.
assumptions.identifiability: Generic public images exist and have been acquired, but exact per-SN reference selection/PSF/scene posterior/zeropoint lineage was not recovered. SMP assumes zero flux outside -40..+300day fit region; released free-flux points cannot test >365day zero-reference assumption.

assumptions.assumption: Negative measurements are valid signed flux likelihood inputs; very negative observations are subject to configured rejection.
assumptions.why_needed: Dropping all negative points would bias faint/late flux upward.
assumptions.empirical_falsifier: Loader positivity censoring or evidence of a more restrictive SNR cutoff than documented.
assumptions.result: Flux residual uses signed FLUXCAL. Default SIGNOISE_REJECT=-9.0; first-iteration rejects below it, in addition to chi-square and phase. Millions of public DIFFIMG and517801SMP records are negative.
assumptions.identifiability: Negative retention alone does not validate error distribution or sample detection selection.

assumptions.assumption: Clipping at first iteration selects an adequate and reproducible set of observations.
assumptions.why_needed: Data-dependent masks can change optimizer basin and invalidate naive accepted-residual Gaussian checks.
assumptions.empirical_falsifier: Different valid starts/versions or fixed-mask arm produce materially different parameters/masks.
assumptions.result: DELCHI2_REJECT10 and first-iteration phase/SNR clipping implemented. CID1256426 has7mask switches between public and refit among same27available records; no corresponding changedflux correction. Conditioned published mask preserves62702acceptedrecords/1635objects.
assumptions.identifiability: Fixed published mask is conditional on original fit, not independent validation.94ambiguous groups,93 retain all candidate multiplicities; one subset ambiguity disclosed.

assumptions.assumption: Published filter transmission/zero-point calibration and rest-wavelength coverage adequately map observed flux to SALT spectral flux.
assumptions.why_needed: Broadband amplitudes and colors depend on passband+calibration; a scalar exposure zeropoint does not encode chromatic corrections.
assumptions.empirical_falsifier: Heldout-band flux residual pattern inconsistent with calibration covariance or independently reconstructed standards/transmission.
assumptions.result: Pinned calibration FITS and SALT3.DES5YR available; configured3500..8000Angstrom restframe andgriz. Original/current PHOT bytesidentical despite calibration/model release updates, so Dovekie distances are not new measured lightcurves.
assumptions.identifiability: Successful use of released calibration is reproducibility, not independent proof. Exact SMP tertiary-star/PSF correction lineage not reconstructed in this wave.

assumptions.assumption: MW extinction is adequately represented by Schlafly-updated E(B-V), Fitzpatrick99 Rv3.1 and its implemented covariance.
assumptions.why_needed: Foreground reddening covaries band flux and inferred SN color.
assumptions.empirical_falsifier: Residuals correlate with independently measured MW reddening or alternate foreground-law prediction improves heldout bands.
assumptions.result: OPT_MWEBV3,OPT_MWCOLORLAW99,RV3.1; covariance uses products of epoch MWfluxerrors across bands.
assumptions.identifiability: No claim this fixed law is universally true; no alternate-law fit passed baselinegate yet.

assumptions.assumption: Published scalar uncertainties and quality masks characterize the analysis-eligible observational subset.
assumptions.why_needed: Mask meaning changes across reductions; silently transplanting DIFFIMG bits can discard accepted SMP epochs.
assumptions.empirical_falsifier: Accepted published records contradict proposed flag rejection rule.
assumptions.result: Public accepted SMP includesbit2,1024,2048; unambiguous acceptedbits4..512excluding2 arezero. Mask32 explains two pilot epoch-count differences but not fullbaseline.
assumptions.identifiability: Observed flagbit distributions are empirical constraints, not complete author mask reconstruction;2accepted rows have possiblebit32 ambiguity.

assumptions.assumption: Selected observed lightcurves and missing hosts/redshifts are correctly conditioned in inference.
assumptions.why_needed: Detection, host-z acquisition and SALT/BBC selection are not missing-at-random observations.
assumptions.empirical_falsifier: Exactcut/denominator inconsistency or selection response changes with latent host/color/redshift not in model.
assumptions.result: All pointers/NOBS rows verify; DES19706SMP versus31636DIFFIMG and1635originalHubble objects are distinct selection levels. Header redshift/host missingness substantial.
assumptions.identifiability: Our off-signal test uses selectedHubbleCIDs, not complete detection universe. No complete flux-based selection normalization inferred from accepted sample alone.

assumptions.assumption: CCD weight map describes local stochastic image noise and weak pixel covariance adequately for a bounded aperture diagnostic.
assumptions.why_needed: This is an independent measurement-level check below SNANA and calibrated lightcurve reduction.
assumptions.empirical_falsifier: Unmasked blank/control pixels and apertures depart strongly from weight-derived variance, or WCS/exposure identity fails.
assumptions.result: 3matched exposures230179g/230180r/230181i atCCD17: exact science crop/weight alignment confirmed, source-screened pixelRMS1.009/1.002/.999 and neighbor products.004–.011;42/40/43screened aperturecontrolsRMS.865/.930/1.061.
assumptions.identifiability: OneSNfield, one observingnight, source-screen conditioned tails, DR2processing not guaranteed exactSMP inputs. No PSFscene refit or cosmological conclusion.

assumptions.assumption: REDCOV0.6 in simulation should be interpreted as correlation of added error-fudge noise, not total observed flux correlation.
assumptions.why_needed: A wrong covariance convention would make data-vs-simulation comparisons misleading.
assumptions.empirical_falsifier: Code algebra or public flux covariance disagrees with the chosen interpretation.
assumptions.result: Historical snlc_sim.c adds fudgevariance(scale²−1)*searchvariance, covariance0.6*sqrt(F_iF_j) withinband/field; independentsearch and fullycorrelatedtemplate terms separate.
assumptions.identifiability: Off-signal raw-pull correlation includes offsets and realvariability and cannot directly estimate thiscomponent coefficient.

assumptions.assumption: Reported fitted SALT parameter covariance is numerically compatible with a Gaussian likelihood.
assumptions.why_needed: A downstream hierarchy requires usable joint uncertainties, not rounded/incompatible entries.
assumptions.empirical_falsifier: Negative eigenvalues or correlations>|1| after faithful public-error reconstruction.
assumptions.result: Original metadata5nonPSD,current11; most originalx0crosscov roundedzero. Code documents MINOSdiagonal/paraboliccross mismatch and optionalrepair.
assumptions.identifiability: Does not prove original optimizer likelihood invalid. Use independently output fullcovariance and report any repair, not silent PSD projection.
